response.sql: WITH member_totals AS (SELECT link_to_member, SUM(amount) AS member_amount FROM income WHERE link_to_member IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_member), shares AS (SELECT member_amount, 1.0 * member_amount / SUM(member_amount) OVER () AS share FROM member_totals), threshold AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_amount) AS total_amount, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - threshold.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE share > threshold.average_share
